scope: Bounded Nix experiment only. Hydra was source-reviewed but not numerically fitted; no failure or success is inferred for Hydra. No camera or texture package changes.

nominal.method: Original full mesh fixed0.5km/source unit. Convex-support silhouette outer constraints at5degree image directions.20percent bright-interior contour; quality-zero finite values only. First image alternating45degree sectors fit attitude+pointing; remaining sectors reserved. Second entire image is an independent shape holdout after fitting only its2D pointing offset. One rigid orientation propagated by historical2016 pole350/42 and1.829day period through actual FITS tangent camera bases. No pixels or texture mapping accepted. Orthographic approximation and phase-dependent limb are acknowledged feasibility limits.

fitsDecode.measurementUnits: calibrated DN; no radiance/I/F claim or adopted photometric conversion
fitsDecode.coordinatePolicy: Original FITS native array coordinates; tangent camera bases from actual CD matrix/CRVAL. Fitted 3D rotations are proper mesh-to-J2000 rotations; body-fixed OPUS labels were not used as mesh coordinates.

limitations: Convex silhouette support is a necessary outer-outline constraint, not the complete concave source-mesh camera visibility/photometric forward model.
No PSF fit or calibrated limb model;10/20/30percent contour sensitivity demonstrates geographic ambiguity.
Historical published poleRA350/Dec42 has about10degree uncertainty. The trial holds it fixed; uncertainty is not reduced by this fit.

Only first-image alternating sectors determine orientation; the second whole exposure independently checks shape after solving its2D pointing offset. Those labelled fitRmsPixels in the second-image numeric array are merely the same angular-sector subset, not orientation-fitting data.
Orthographic support approximates the perspective camera at ratio24.3km/60485km; maximum projected change at81pixel radius is about0.033pixel, smaller than measured residuals.
Reported source-model axes and orientation are not absolute IAU cartographic registration.
No accepted surface pixels, new package camera, texture bake or browser qualification.

borderPolicy: Observed support witnesses at or within3 native pixels of an image edge are excluded before fitting/qualification. Final numbers supersede the preliminary unconstrained-border experiment.
decision: Review recommendation only; original12-body cohort remains in scope. Carry Nix registered imagery: plausible bounded outlines exist but the geographic pose is ambiguous. A complete source-mesh visibility/landmark/photometric and PSF model, additional angular views and pole-uncertainty exploration are required before accepting camera controls or surface pixels.

reproduction.inputs: Two exact FITS files listed in sourcePins and the gzip STL stored as nix.stl. Decode first; repeat fit with.1 and.3 for sensitivity. Requires Python/numpy/Pillow. No browser or package preparation.
